python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('inventory/models.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('

def low_stock(items, threshold=5):
    return [item for item in items if item.quantity < threshold]
') == 1, 'inventory/models.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('

def low_stock(items, threshold=5):
    return [item for item in items if item.quantity < threshold]
', '').encode())
p = pathlib.Path('inventory/report.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('from .models import low_stock, total_value') == 1, 'inventory/report.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('from .models import low_stock, total_value', 'from .models import total_value
from .alerts import low_stock').encode())
p = pathlib.Path('tests/test_models.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('from inventory.models import Item, low_stock, total_value') == 1, 'tests/test_models.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('from inventory.models import Item, low_stock, total_value', 'from inventory.models import Item, total_value
from inventory.alerts import low_stock').encode())
pathlib.Path('inventory/alerts.py').write_text('"""Stock level rules."""


def low_stock(items, threshold=5):
    return [item for item in items if item.quantity < threshold]
')
